translations.english: He's trying to tell me what he wants.
translations.japanese: 彼は何が欲しいか私に言おうとしています。
translations.notes: Progressive attempt construction with embedded question

translations.english: He's going to ask you tomorrow.
translations.japanese: 彼は明日あなたに聞くつもりです。
translations.notes: Future intention with tsumori

translations.english: He's just started to learn.
translations.japanese: 彼は習い始めたばかりです。
translations.notes: Recent past with bakari; hajimeru compound verb

translations.english: He would give you an answer if he could.
translations.japanese: できれば、彼はあなたに答えをあげるでしょう。
translations.notes: Conditional with dekireba; deshou for hypothetical

translations.english: The man is trying to help me.
translations.japanese: その男の人は私を手伝おうとしています。
verbal_collocations_japanese: 手伝おうとしています
translations.notes: Attempt construction with volitional + to suru

translations.english: That man is going to tell me something new.
translations.japanese: あの男の人は何か新しいことを私に言うつもりです。
translations.notes: Future intention; nanika atarashii koto for something new

translations.english: That man has just started to practise speaking.
translations.japanese: あの男の人は話す練習を始めたばかりです。
translations.notes: Compound with renshuu; recent past bakari

translations.english: That woman would help you if she could.
translations.japanese: できれば、あの女の人はあなたを手伝うでしょう。
translations.notes: Conditional hypothetical parallel to 224

translations.english: I know a young man who wants to work with you.
translations.japanese: あなたと一緒に働きたい若い男の人を知っています。
verbal_collocations_japanese: 男の人を知っています
translations.notes: ZUT: know (person) = 知る; relative clause prenominal

translations.english: I know an old man who wanted to ask for help.
translations.japanese: 助けを求めたかった年配の男の人を知っています。
verbal_collocations_japanese: 男の人を知っています
translations.notes: ZUT: know (person) = 知る; ask for = motomeru

translations.english: I know an old woman who can remember the answer.
translations.japanese: 答えを覚えられる年配の女の人を知っています。
verbal_collocations_japanese: 女の人を知っています
translations.notes: ZUT: remember (retain) = 覚える; can remember = potential form

translations.english: I know a young woman who knows your sister.
translations.japanese: あなたのお姉さんを知っている若い女の人を知っています。
verbal_collocations_japanese: 女の人を知っています
お姉さんを知っている
translations.notes: Both instances are know (person) = 知る

translations.english: I met someone last night who works with your brother.
translations.japanese: 昨夜、あなたのお兄さんと一緒に働いている人に会いました。
translations.notes: ZUT: meet = 会う; relative clause describes person

translations.english: I met someone who said that he wanted to tell you something.
translations.japanese: あなたに何か言いたいと言った人に会いました。
translations.notes: Embedded quote with to iu; want + verb = tai form

translations.english: I know someone who said that she was going to try to help.
translations.japanese: 手伝おうとするつもりだと言った人を知っています。
translations.notes: Complex embedded structure; attempt + intention

translations.english: He wanted me to tell you before the weekend.
translations.japanese: 彼は週末の前にあなたに言ってほしかったです。
translations.notes: Want someone to do = te-form + hoshii

translations.english: He wanted you to tell me yesterday.
translations.japanese: 彼は昨日私に言ってほしかったです。
translations.notes: Want someone to do = te-form + hoshii; parallel to 236

translations.english: My mother likes to read.
translations.japanese: 母は読むのが好きです。
translations.notes: Like doing = verb + no ga suki

translations.english: My father doesn't like to stop talking.
translations.japanese: 父は話すのをやめるのが好きではありません。
translations.notes: Nested nominalization; stop + gerund = no wo yameru

translations.english: I don't want to give it to him.
translations.japanese: 彼にそれをあげたくないです。
translations.notes: Negative desire; ageru for giving to third party

translations.english: I want to give her more time.
translations.japanese: 彼女にもっと時間をあげたいです。
translations.notes: Positive desire; parallel structure to 240

translations.english: I'm going to ask for the same thing to eat.
translations.japanese: 同じ食べ物を頼むつもりです。
translations.notes: Future intention; ask for (order) = tanomu; tabemono is more natural than modifier

translations.english: I've learnt a lot already.
translations.japanese: もうたくさん習いました。
translations.notes: Present perfect as completed action; mou for already

translations.english: I'm happy with how much I've done in a short time.
translations.japanese: 短い時間でどれだけできたかに満足しています。
translations.notes: Embedded question; manzoku for happy/satisfied with results

translations.english: I wanted her to help you but she was too busy.
translations.japanese: 彼女にあなたを手伝ってほしかったですが、忙しすぎました。
translations.notes: Want someone to do + contrast; sugiru for too much

translations.english: I thought that book was fairly good.
translations.japanese: その本はまあまあ良かったと思いました。
translations.notes: ZUT: think that X = Xと思う (opinion); maamaa for fairly

translations.english: I thought the film was complete rubbish and I want my money back.
translations.japanese: その映画は本当にひどかったと思いました。お金を返してほしいです。
translations.notes: ZUT: think that = to omou; hidoi for rubbish; want X back = kaeshite hoshii

translations.english: I want you to help me before you go.
translations.japanese: 行く前に手伝ってほしいです。
translations.notes: Want someone to do = te-hoshii; mae ni for before

translations.english: Can you tell me something else before I answer?
translations.japanese: 答える前に他に何か言ってもらえますか。
translations.notes: Request form with morau potential; hoka ni nanika for something else

translations.english: I don't want to find out until after we finish.
translations.japanese: 終わってからまで知りたくないです。
translations.notes: ZUT: find out = 知る; te-kara made for until after

translations.english: I don't want to find out until after we finish.
translations.japanese: 終わってからまで知りたくないです。
translations.notes: Duplicate of 250

translations.english: When will you be ready to start?
translations.japanese: いつ始める準備ができますか。
translations.notes: Ready = junbi ga dekiru; embedded purpose

translations.english: I should be ready in a few minutes.
translations.japanese: 数分で準備ができるはずです。
translations.notes: Should = hazu; expectation/likelihood

translations.english: I've been ready since this morning.
translations.japanese: 今朝から準備ができています。
translations.notes: Continuous state with te-iru; kara for since

translations.english: When do you think you'll be ready to leave?
translations.japanese: いつ出かける準備ができると思いますか。
verbal_collocations_japanese: 出かける準備ができる
translations.notes: ZUT: think that = to omou; embedded question with itsu

translations.english: I think I'll be ready in less than an hour.
translations.japanese: 一時間以内に準備ができると思います。
translations.notes: ZUT: think that = to omou; inai for less than

translations.english: I like that blue thing.
translations.japanese: あの青いものが好きです。
translations.notes: Like = suki; mono for thing

translations.english: What's that blue thing over there?
translations.japanese: あそこにあるあの青いものは何ですか。
translations.notes: Asoko ni aru for over there; demonstrative ano

translations.english: An idea.
translations.japanese: アイデアです。
translations.notes: Noun phrase; no verb; loan word aideo commonly used

translations.english: I don't have the faintest idea.
translations.japanese: 全然わかりません。
translations.notes: ZUT: understand = わかる; zenzen + negative for emphasis; idiomatic expression

want (self).pattern: verb-stem + tai for self; hoshii for things

ask.pattern: kiku for questions; tanomu for requests/orders

know (person/fact).pattern: shiru - ZUT compliant for knowing people/facts

think (opinion).pattern: omou - ZUT: think that X = X to omou
